g.text: The rise is a change of mixture

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: The cell ranking survives how the score was built; the glucose effect size does not
GSE289733 Th17n cells | A-B, Wp-P01 variant scores against the published definition; C, Wp-P03 Kitagawa
decomposition of the same glucose difference into mixture and within-programme parts
Every variant uses the same cells and the same expression matrix, so agreement between them is the absence of a gene-selection artefact, not independent evidence. In B, circles
are animal Mo1 and triangles Mo2. In C the within-programme term has opposite signs in the two animals and is reported inconclusive; programmes are defined from the same
expression as the score, so part of the mixture term is guaranteed by construction.
